title: The blown fuse
prompt: A 12 V lamp circuit with a fuse stops working. The meter reads 12 V across the fuse and 0 V across the lamp.
explanation: The part with the full supply across it is the open one: the fuse has blown. The lamp reads 0 V only because no current flows.

lines: The lamp reads 0 V, so no current flows through it
The fuse reads the full 12 V
A good fuse would drop almost 0 V
So the lamp is the open part
